privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
The principle

This site is designed to work without collecting personal data. There is no account, no sign-up and no targeted advertising.

Cookies

This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. That is why no consent banner is forced upon you. Only your language preference may be stored in your browser, at your request, and it never leaves your device.

Audience measurement

Traffic is measured in an anonymous and aggregated way, without cookies and without individual identifiers: you cannot be recognised from one visit to the next.

Your rights

Under the GDPR you have rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection. To exercise them, write to {{contact}}.

Removal requests

If you believe information published here concerns you — for example a nickname or a wallet address — you may request its removal by writing to {{contact}}. Every request is reviewed and handled promptly.

This prohibition applies including to holders of member access. Tracing elements allow the origin of a copy to be identified.
